name: orquestrador-maestro
tagline_zh: 代码与项目总在多个工具间跳来跳去？让编排大师用统一契约接管切换，像指挥家一样让每个工具各就各位，一次对齐，全程同步。
tagline_en: Tired of juggling tools? Maestro applies one shared contract to code and project work—so every tool falls in.
desc_en: Aplica o contrato compartilhado do Orquestrador Maestro ao trabalho de código e projeto.
why_zh: 它把分散工具的隐性约定固化成显式契约，让协作不再靠口头对齐，而是靠代码级约束自动同步。
why_en: It turns implicit tool conventions into an explicit, code-level contract—so coordination happens automatically, not by memory or.
